name: August Tyrant Style (Combat, Style)
body:
You plow through victims with primal fury.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +1 or one natural attack

Benefits: When fighting using this style, your unarmed strikes deal +1 damage, +1 for every 4 BAB you possess. Once per round, you may cause an opponent you successfully damaged with an unarmed strike to be knocked off-balance, taking a -1 penalty to AC until the end of their next turn. Creatures immune to being tripped are immune to this penalty. This bonus damage does not apply to touch attacks or effects that do not deal hit point damage.

Special: This feat’s benefits apply to two-handed weapons and natural attacks. A monk treats his monk level as his BAB for this feat’s benefits.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
